objective: Add a read-only Treasury Wave 7 gate that compares later verified baseline/candidate route outcomes and emits deterministic human-review evidence without acquiring economic authority.

rulesConsidered: Treasurer remains the only production economic-admission and settlement authority.
Economic Intelligence and promotion eligibility are read-only and advisory.
Only subsequent, F07-receipted outcomes may support a promotion candidate.
Sample/confidence, verification/non-inferiority, latency, and realized savings gates remain independent.
Legacy economic facades cannot authorize production spend.
The evidence artifact cannot mutate Treasury, alter routing, execute providers, or grant AER/Ascalon authority.

security.notes: The code change adds a pure read-only evaluator and tests. No keys or provider credentials are embedded. Security/runtime scan evidence remains a CI gate.

changes: Added a deterministic SHA-256-digested artifact for comparing later F07-receipted baseline and candidate route outcomes.
Enforced distinct route/cohort identities and exact workload/capability matching.
Added outcome/F07 receipt uniqueness, time-window and numeric validation.
Added independent sample/confidence, verification non-inferiority, P90 latency regression and realized-cost savings checks.
Added tests for eligible outcome sets and failure modes including stale/unverified/duplicate/mismatched evidence.
Changed reliability benchmark REL-006 to exercise the Treasury Kernel's unfunded-spend denial instead of CostGovernor.
Removed legacy CostGovernor and MissionBudgetManager exports from the primary FactoryOS barrel and made the compatibility scan inspect that barrel.
Migrated the Frontier V3 runtime test away from the removed CostGovernor barrel export; paid-spend denial remains tested through canonical Treasury Kernel tests.
Removed the unused CostGovernor import from canonical RegressionMissions.
Migrated FactoryBench Scenario 12 from deprecated AgentEconomicsEngine tier heuristics to current CapabilityFirstRouter provider selection, explicitly retaining the selection/admission boundary.
Decoupled production trajectory eligibility tests from the legacy AgentEconomicsEngine using the CognitiveOutcomeLearner telemetry-sink contract.
Archived the Phase 9 economics telemetry and Phase 13 heuristic routing tests as source-history documents because their assertions described the retired local heuristic, not Treasury admission.
Retained the StrategicMetaThinker investigation test while archiving its obsolete AgentEconomicsEngine routing/metrics tests.
